raw.cause: camera's handler wedged on its 6th frame request: it received display's message (58328) but never called MsgReply, because camera_handle loops in pause() once camera_frames > 5. display's main loop calls MsgSend to camera synchronously on the drawing thread with no isolation, so thread 1 stays REPLY-blocked forever (-58319) and stops talking to nav and logger. A TimerTimeout alone would not help: the name_attach channel has _NTO_CHF_UNBLOCK, so the client stays blocked until the wedged camera handles the unblock pulse, which it never does.
raw.qnx_call: MsgSend in display (main loop, blocking on camera); MsgReply missing in camera
raw.fix_summary: Move the camera MsgSend out of display's drawing loop into a dedicated reader thread, and have the loop only read the last frame under a mutex, showing 'camera stale' when it is old. A hung or dead camera then blocks only the reader thread while display keeps asking nav and drawing. This is what COCKPIT_FIXED=1 enables; make it the unconditional behaviour. Also fix the camera so it replies or returns MsgError instead of pausing forever.

finding: camera stopped answering and took display down with it
